applies_to: Functional Devices RIBMNW24B-44-BC BACnet MS/TP module with four binary inputs and four relays.
summary: A BACnet MS/TP I/O module with four binary inputs and four relay outputs. Each relay has a priority array, minimum on/off times and a writable relinquish default.
notes: Object names are user-writable and the PICS prints no factory default name, so each object is listed by its printed ID (BI1, BO1...). Names are limited to 4 characters.
Binary input text defaults to OFF/ON (up to 4 characters, writable); polarity can be reversed.
The PICS header prints the model as "RIBMW24B-44-BC" and Model_Name as "RIBMW24B-44BC".

integration.summary: Command BO1-BO4 and read BI1-BI4; there is no on-board logic.
setup: The PICS prints the device object ID default as DEV277000 (vendor ID 277); it is writable.
MS/TP master; baud rates are listed in the PICS. Max_Master defaults to 127.

note: Provided as-is. Point availability varies by firmware and options; verify against the live device.
